_metadata.description: Safety/disposition compatibility display contract. Quality ratings are emitted separately in quality_tier. POOR remains only for older cached catalogs and is never emitted by the current scorer.
_metadata.status: LOCKED — catalog visibility separated from quality assessment October8,2026
_metadata.purpose: Current safety/disposition compatibility IDs are SAFE, CAUTION, BLOCKED and UNSAFE. POOR is a retired quality alias readable in older catalogs; it makes no safety claim.

field_contract.id: Stable compatibility identifier. Consumer safety comes from product_safety_status; consumer quality comes from quality_tier. POOR is read-only compatibility for older catalogs.
field_contract.name: Full user-facing label (sentence case). Shown in detail screens and full-text contexts.
field_contract.short_label: Compact chip / pill label. ≤12 chars. Shown in search-result tiles and dense list views.
field_contract.tone: Semantic intent for theming. One of: positive, neutral, info, warning, danger.
field_contract.ui_color: Color hint Flutter resolves to a theme color. One of: green, blue, gray, yellow, orange, red.
field_contract.ui_icon: Icon hint Flutter resolves to an icon asset. One of: check, info, warning, alert, block.
field_contract.action: Suggested user action verb-phrase (≤40 chars). Shown beneath the verdict in product detail.
field_contract.notes: ≤200-char plain-English description shown in tap-to-learn modal.

_metadata.pipeline_contract_note: NOT_SCORED may ship a confidently matched source label with no quality score or tier and independently valid safety warnings. NUTRITION_ONLY remains retired. Product-match and payload-integrity failures remain quarantined.

verdicts.name: Safe
verdicts.notes: No catalog safety concern was identified in the assessed label. This disposition makes no claim about quality, personal suitability or absence of every risk.

verdicts.name: Caution
verdicts.notes: Catalog findings require review before use. Product quality is rated separately; personal interactions and suitability are assessed separately.

verdicts.name: Poor quality
verdicts.notes: This is an older catalog quality label. Current quality ratings use quality_tier; this label makes no safety claim.

verdicts.name: Do not use
verdicts.notes: Product contains a banned, recalled, or otherwise prohibited substance. Do not use. Consult your provider or pharmacist if you have already been taking it.

verdicts.name: Unsafe
verdicts.notes: Product has critical safety flags (high-dose contraindications, severe interaction risk, or regulatory adverse events). Do not use without medical supervision.

verdicts.name: Score unavailable
verdicts.notes: Product label information is available, but its quality assessment is incomplete. This makes no safety claim. Independently verified warnings remain visible.
